newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Berkshire to sell 7.8 pct of Tranz Rail.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire to sell 7.8 pct of Tranz Rail.

text.p: Tranz Rail Holdings said on Thursday that it had filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale by the Berkshire Fund III of 9.84 million ordinary shares.

The sale will be in the form of American Depository Shares or ordinary shares in concurrent U.S. and international offerings. The shares on offer represent about 7.8 percent of the outstanding shares.
Berkshire Fund III currently holds 13.51 percent of Tranz Rail, which operates railway and interisland ferry services in New Zealand.
Tranz Rail said provision had been made for the number of shares being offered to be increased by up to 15 percent to cover over-allotments.
Berkshire previously sold five million Tranz Rail shares in November 1996 at NZ$7.50 per share.
Tranz Rail said Goldman Sachs and Co would be the global coordinator for the offerings.
Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp owns 22.65 percent of Tranz Rail. New Zealand merchant bank Fay Richwhite, through Pacific Rail, owns 18.73 percent.
Tranz Rail shares were 15 cents lower at $8.50 in mid-morning trade. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
